title: Sidewalk supports.
officialText:
Exterior foundation walls are permitted to be constructed with a ledge that projects beyond the
street line not more than 4 inches (102 mm) to support sidewalk construction, provided that:
1. the top of the ledge is not more than 8 inches (203 mm) below the ground or sidewalk level; and
2. bottom of the ledge is not more than 24 inches (610 mm) below the ground or sidewalk level.
